data.title: 篝之雾枝 · 深红玫瑰园的拂晓凝视
data.description: 雾气未散的古堡庭院内，带刺的深红玫瑰在朝露中绽放。雾枝裹着真丝长袍漫步其间，指尖轻抚一片沾着露水的花瓣，平日里傲慢的神情在清晨的微光中化为一丝罕见的落寞。
data.location: ancient overgrown castle rose garden shrouded in ethereal morning ground mist
data.action: wandering stone pathway wrapped loosely in trailing red silk peignoir, touching a thorny dark red rose petal with gentle melancholy longing
data.lighting: cool pearlescent dawn mist illuminated by faint rosy morning sunbeams
data.mood: lonely immortal melancholy, fragile noble beauty, breathtaking poetic stillness
data.promptProse: Strolling through a misty rose garden at dawn, Kirie touches dark roses in her red silk robe with a serene, wistful expression.
data.animaCaption: Kirie wandering an overgrown misty rose garden at dawn in her crimson silk robe.
